transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… my talking’s been getting mixed up. I try to explain something, like the keys, then it turns into jail, then a prayer rug, chess pieces… and people say they can’t follow me. So… that’s why I’m here.
Do you feel like your thoughts are jumbled or hard to organize when this happens?

Yeah… it gets jumbled. I start with one thing, like the keys, and then it goes to jail, then the prayer rug, then chess pieces. In my head it… sort of connects, but when I say it, people tell me they can’t follow me.
Do you believe the connections between keys, jail, prayer rug, and chess pieces are real, or do they just feel that way when you're talking?

I don’t know if they’re… real like that. It just feels connected when I’m saying it. I start with the keys, then somehow it goes to jail, then the prayer rug and chess pieces, and people say they can’t follow me.
Do you think the connections between these things, like keys and jail, are actually true, or just a product of your own thoughts?

I mean… some of it feels like just my head making jumps. But other times, no. Like at work, even when my supervisor showed me there was nothing on the camera, I still felt sure the building people had marked me somehow… using the hallway lights and little looks to warn each other about me.
Do you still believe the building people have marked you somehow, even after your supervisor showed you there was nothing on the camera?

Yeah… I still felt that way. Even after he showed me the camera, it didn’t really settle it for me. I still thought they’d marked me somehow… with the hallway lights, and those looks they give each other.
Do you still think the building people are against you or trying to warn others about you?

Yeah… I still think something’s going on. I know you’re saying maybe it’s not, and my supervisor showed me the camera, but it didn’t change how it felt. The lights in the hallway, the way they look at each other… it feels like they’re warning people about me.
Do you think the connections between keys, jail, prayer rug, and chess pieces are happening because of something going on outside of your own thoughts?

Yeah… I think it’s more than just in my head. Like I said, even after my supervisor showed me there was nothing on the camera, I still felt like the building people had marked me somehow… using the hallway lights and little looks to warn each other.
Do you think the building people are actually trying to harm you or is it just that they're watching you?

I don’t know if they’d actually hurt me… but it feels like they marked me. Like they’re watching and warning each other with the lights and the looks. Even after the camera thing, I still felt sure about that.

Do you think the connections between these things, like keys and jail, are happening because you're trying to make sense of something that's actually going on, or because your mind is making unusual links?

I don’t know… it gets mixed up when I try to say it. Like I start with the keys, then it goes to jail, then the prayer rug, chess pieces… and people say they can’t follow me. I’m trying to make sense of it, but my talking just comes out all tangled.
Do you think the building people's supposed actions against you are the main reason for your jumbled thoughts when explaining things?

I don’t know if that’s the main reason. It’s more… when I try to explain it, my words get mixed up. I start with the keys, then jail, then the prayer rug and chess pieces, and people tell me they can’t follow me.
Do you think the building people's actions against you are real?

Yeah… I mean, it feels real to me. Even after my supervisor showed me there wasn’t anything on the camera, I still felt like they had marked me somehow… using the hallway lights and those little looks to warn each other about me.
Can anything change your mind about the building people marking you?

I don’t know. I mean… even when my supervisor showed me there wasn’t anything on the camera, I still felt like they had marked me. Like with the hallway lights, and the little looks. It’s hard to just let that go.
Do you think there's any possibility that the building people are not actually against you?

Maybe… I guess there’s a possibility. But it doesn’t feel that way to me. Even after my supervisor showed me nothing was on the camera, I still felt like they’d marked me somehow… with the hallway lights and those looks. I can’t shake that.
How certain are you that the building people have actually marked you?

Pretty certain. I mean… even with the camera thing, when my supervisor said there was nothing there, I still felt like they’d marked me. The lights and the looks… it feels like that’s what they’re doing.
Do you think it's possible that your feelings about the building people are not based on real events?

I guess… maybe it’s possible. But it doesn’t feel that way to me. Even when my supervisor said there was nothing on the camera, I still felt sure they’d marked me somehow… with the hallway lights and the looks.
Do you think your belief about the building people marking you will ever change?

I don’t know… maybe, but it hasn’t changed so far. Even when my supervisor showed me nothing on the camera, I still felt like they’d marked me somehow. The lights, the looks… it still feels like they’re warning each other about me.
Do you think the building people's actions against you are something that could happen in real life?
Yeah… I mean, I think it could. People can warn each other, you know. Even if nothing showed on the camera, I still felt like they’d marked me somehow… with the lights and the looks.
Do you think the building people's actions against you are based on something they've actually done or is it just your interpretation of their behavior?

I mean… it feels like something they’re actually doing. I know my supervisor said the camera didn’t show anything, but I still felt sure they’d marked me somehow. The lights in the hallway, the little looks… it seemed like they were warning each other about me.
Do you think your belief about the building people marking you could be completely wrong?

I guess it could be… but it doesn’t feel wrong to me. Even after my supervisor showed me nothing on the camera, I still felt like they’d marked me somehow. The hallway lights, the looks… it felt like they were warning each other.
Do you think the building people's actions against you are something that most people would find hard to believe?

Yeah… probably. Most people probably would say it sounds hard to believe. But to me it still felt real, even when the camera didn’t show anything. The lights and the looks… it felt like they were signaling about me.
